desc: Compute counts c_d and sums S_d for numbers with d digits (d=1..6).
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N.
Build polynomial H(z) = ∏_d (1 + w_d z)^{c_d} using binomial coefficients and NTT multiplication.
Build series R(z) = ∑_d S_d * w_d * z/(1 + w_d z) truncated to degree N-1.
Compute Q(z) = H(z) * R(z) truncated to degree N-1.
Extract A_k and B_k from coefficients of H and Q.
Implement NTT for modulus 998244353 with primitive root 3.
Implement polynomial multiplication using NTT with truncation to degree N.
Implement pow for (1 + w_d z)^{c_d} via binomial series using precomputed factorials.
Compute answer = ∑_{k=0}^{N-1} (N-k-1)! * k! * (total_sum * A_k - B_k) mod 998244353.
Run the program on sample input N=3 to verify output 1332.
Run the program on sample input N=390 to verify output 727611652.
